component.name: Openlive helper
component.summary: Stream your screen or a window to an Openlive room

description.p: The native helper of Openlive, a self-hosted place for groups to watch each other's screens. It captures a monitor or a window through the desktop's screen-sharing portal, encodes it on the GPU (NVENC or VA-API, x264 as the fallback) and publishes it with WebRTC. The web app starts, pauses and stops streams; no port is opened on this machine.
Pair it once with your instance with "openlive-helper pair --instance URL".
First packaged build: Linux capture through the portal, NVENC, VA-API and x264.
